topic: 5 Rules for Surviving Peak Season D2C Logistics

slides.headline: Most D2C brands don't fail marketing in Q4—they fail logistics.
slides.body_copy: Surat fabric delays, packaging shortages in Bhiwandi, and courier NDRs can wipe out your Diwali margin in 72 hours.

slides.headline: Rule #1: Pre-book express air courier allocations early
slides.body_copy: Surface cargo gets jammed 10 days before Diwali. Secure guaranteed 48-hour air freight lanes for high-velocity SKUs.

slides.headline: Rule #2: Keep 3-day buffer on fabric approvals
slides.body_copy: If dyeing delays occur in Surat, an unbuffered downstream pattern mockup ruins your entire lookbook photoshoot schedule.

slides.headline: Rule #3: Daily automated slip tracking from standups
slides.body_copy: Never let vendor delays live in someone's head. Run automated DAG slip cascades to catch bottlenecks before deadlines break.

slides.headline: Execution is the only marketing that matters in Q4.
slides.body_copy: Share with your D2C operations team. Follow @justsortd for daily playbooks.
